hidden.explanation: 1 is a candidate here. Every other empty square in row 6 is blocked from taking 1 by its column or box. This square must take 1.

locked.explanation: In that box, 1 fits only at row 5, column 5 or row 5, column 6. Those squares share row 5, so 1 cannot also appear at the marked square outside the box.
